description:
Equip Impulsive Pilferer with Lightning Greaves.
Sacrifice Impulsive Pilferer to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Impulsive Pilferer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Koll triggers, returning Impulsive Pilferer to your hand.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer.
Repeat.
